Header path: macos-arm64/needle.h
License path: LICENSE

The Rust declarations in src/engine.rs use only needle_load,
needle_transcribe and needle_last_error. The prebuilt runtime is downloaded
separately by explicit install. The upstream runtime implementation is private.
